capabilities: Open a paper-style picker by clicking a Date or Date & time property
Pick dates and times with mouse, touch, or keyboard navigation
Preserve existing time values and save via processFrontMatter with conflict checks
Localize the picker in English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese
Translate Animal Island Cozy theme settings in memory via Style Settings
disambiguation: Not an event planner or daily-note sidebar calendar; it only fills Date and Date & time property values.
extras: Initial beta tested only on macOS (Obsidian 1.14.5); iOS native-picker suppression still needs physical-device confirmation and Windows, Linux, and popout windows are not fully verified. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A cozy paper-style date and time picker for Obsidian note Properties.
problem: Obsidian's native Date property controls are plain; it adds a themed, keyboard-navigable calendar picker for setting property values.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Animal Island UI, created by guokaigdg
Works on its own, and coordinates with Animal Island Cozy

summary: Paper-style date and time picker for Date and Date & time note Properties, with keyboard navigation and English/Chinese language support.
